detailedSolution:

According to NCERT principles for History of Buddhism and Jainism (Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings) (Sanchi Stupa and Buddhist Architecture):
The Begums of Bhopal (Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum) funding preservation and museum construction on-site

Detailed Solution:

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
